owner_column_answers_json.Fecha: fecha en que se realizó la venta
owner_column_answers_json.Hora: hora en que se realizó la venta
owner_column_answers_json.CanalVenta: canal por el que se realizó la venta
owner_column_answers_json.Empleado: empleado que registró o realizó la venta

operator_inputs.semantic_owner_answers_rule: After first pass, create an object whose keys are product_pipeline.owner_questions[*].column_name and whose values are one allowed option id from product_pipeline.owner_questions[*].allowed_option_ids; do not use free text.

output_contract.first_pass_result: JSON at --result-json; must include product_pipeline.owner_questions when status is NEEDS_OWNER_CONFIRMATION.
output_contract.final_pass_result: JSON at --result-json; must include product_pipeline.tools_executed=true for explicit tool mode.
output_contract.delivery_artifact: At least one .xlsx file under --output-dir after final explicit tool pass.
output_contract.plan_only_result: JSON at --result-json; product_pipeline.computation_plan.status must be READY_FOR_COMPUTATION and tools_executed must be false.

pass_criteria: The first pass blocks with NEEDS_OWNER_CONFIRMATION when semantic owner answers are absent.
Semantic answers use only allowed option ids from owner_questions.
The final explicit-tool pass returns PRODUCT_PIPELINE_READY.
The final explicit-tool pass writes at least one XLSX artifact.
The plan-only LIQ_001 path returns COMPUTATION_PLAN_READY without execution.
blocked_criteria: Missing owner column answers when column confirmation is required.
Free-text semantic owner answers instead of allowed option ids.
forbidden_claims: No automatic tool selection from workbook content.
No LIQ_001 execution in this MVP; LIQ_001 reaches plan only.
